environment.description: Bare-metal Ubuntu 22.04 server running the Flask app via gunicorn behind nginx reverse proxy. The app process runs as 'deploy' user with sudo access to git and shell. WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty string (signature verification effectively disabled). Network: port 8080 exposed internally, nginx proxies external HTTPS traffic to it. No additional process isolation.

config.network: nginx reverse proxy, TLS termination, no request filtering
